work.title: Add jittered backoff to client retries, with load test

body: You traced last week's retry storm to retries firing in lockstep, fixed it with jittered backoff, and added a load test so it can't quietly come back. On-call hasn't been paged for it since, and I finally slept through a Tuesday night. That's the kind of care that makes everyone's nights better.
channel_post: Kudos to Bea for the retry fix in #482. She traced last week's retry storm to retries firing in lockstep, fixed it with jittered backoff, and added a load test so it stays fixed. Two weeks without a retry page. Thank you, Bea, for the care that makes everyone's on-call quieter.
manager_note: Hi Sam, I wanted you to know about Bea's work on #482. She found the root cause of last week's retry storm that three of us had missed, fixed it, and added a load test and a runbook note without being asked. On-call has been quiet since. It's exactly the ownership we talk about, and it's worth remembering at review time.
public_post: Shout-out to Bea Ramos, who made our open-source client's retries smarter this month. Her change spreads out reconnect attempts, so apps using the library recover from network blips without overwhelming the servers behind them.
What I admire most: she wrote the tests and the docs before anyone asked. Thank you, Bea. #opensource #reliability

consent.note: Bea said yes to being named and tagged; the client library is open source and the fix is in the public release notes.
